title: Evaluating Modern RAG: Textual, Multimodal, Dense, and Late Interaction Pipelines
abstract: arXiv:2608.23176v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) systems have traditionally relied on text-based pipelines that extract and retrieve information from documents. While efficient and lightweight, these approaches often struggle with documents where meaning is conveyed through layout, tables, and visual elements. Recent advances in multimodal pipelines, powered by vision-language models (VLMs), improve retrieval quality by jointly encoding visual and textual signals, but at increased computational and memory cost. We propose a quantitative, data-driven selection methodology that guides practitioners in choosing the most appropriate RAG pipeline for a given document corpus based on empirical effectiveness and resource constraints. We evaluate contemporary textual and multimodal pipelines, including dense and late-interaction architectures, analyze their trade-offs, and provide actionable guidance for balancing retrieval performance with system efficienc

translated_title: 评估现代RAG：文本、多模态、稠密和晚期交互管道
translated_abstract: 检索增强生成（RAG）系统传统上依赖于基于文本的管道，从文档中提取和检索信息。虽然这些方法高效且轻量，但往往在处理通过布局、表格和视觉元素传达含义的文档时遇到困难。近期，由视觉语言模型（VLMs）驱动的多模态管道进展，通过联合编码视觉和文本信号提高了检索质量，但代价是增加了计算和内存开销。我们提出了一种量化的、数据驱动的选择方法，基于实证效果和资源约束，指导从业者为给定文档语料库选择最合适的RAG管道。我们评估了当代文本和多模态管道，包括稠密和晚期交互架构，分析了它们的权衡，并提供了在检索性能与系统效率之间取得平衡的可操作指导。
tldr: 本文提出了一种数据驱动的选择方法，帮助从业者根据文档语料库的实证效果和资源限制，在文本、多模态、稠密和晚期交互等现代RAG管道之间做出最优权衡选择。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a data-driven selection methodology to guide practitioners in optimally choosing among modern RAG pipelines—textual, multimodal, dense, and late interaction—based on empirical effectiveness and resource constraints.
